2608.21027.title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents
2608.21027.paper_summary: LLM agents are emerging as an important paradigm for real-world tasks that require reasoning, tool use, and sequential decision-making. As these agents operate over longer horizons, runtime intervention offers a way to improve reliability without retraining the underlying actor. Failure detection alone is insufficient. Effective intervention must also provide a useful direction for recovery. Existing approaches often rely on an expert solver or a critic that generates task-specific corrections, incurring either the cost of another capable solver or the capacity demands of a task-capable critic. We introduce Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA), a comparison-only framework for constructive runtime intervention. In COTA, a tiny comparator judges whether sampled alternatives lead to better continuations than the actor's proposal, and repeated comparisons determine when intervention is warranted. We train the comparator using pairwise supervision constructed from same-prefix counterfactual branches. Preferred alternatives are returned as non-binding advice, leaving the original actor to replan. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and tau^3-Retail with three actors, COTA improves all nine evaluation settings and outperforms the compared baselines. These results show that constructive runtime intervention can remain effective even when the auxiliary model has substantially weaker task-solving capability than the actor.
2608.21027.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理正在成為需要推理、工具使用和序列決策的現實世界任務的重要範式。<lb/>隨著這些代理在更長的時間範圍內運作，運行時介入提供了一種在不重新訓練基礎演員的情況下提高可靠性的方法。<lb/>僅僅檢測失敗是不夠的。<lb/>有效的介入還必須提供有用的恢復方向。<lb/>現有的方法通常依賴於專家解決者或生成任務特定修正的評論者，這要麼承擔了另一個有能力的解決者的成本，要麼承擔了任務能力評論者的容量需求。<lb/>我們介紹了僅比較的微型顧問（COTA），這是一個僅進行比較的建設性運行時介入框架。<lb/>在 COTA 中，一個微型比較器判斷所採樣的替代方案是否比演員的提案導致更好的延續，並通過重複比較來確定何時需要介入。<lb/>我們使用從相同前綴的反事實分支構建的成對監督來訓練比較器。<lb/>首選的替代方案作為非約束性建議返回，讓原始演員重新規劃。<lb/>在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 tau^3-Retail 三個演員的評估中，COTA 改進了所有九個評估設置並超越了比較基準。<lb/>這些結果顯示，即使輔助模型的任務解決能力顯著弱於演員，建設性的運行時介入仍然可以保持有效。
